is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles funestus group and Anopheles gambiae complex mosquitoes trapped outdoors in Kenya (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Screened mosquitoes for the L119F-GSTe2 mutation (Page 1, Abstract; Page 4, 'Low levels of L119F-GSTe2 resistance alleles detected in An. funestus group and polymorphism analysis'; Page 7, Methodology).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts are directly reported on Page 4: 'The frequency in the former species was 15.6% (1-RR, 3-RS, 12-SS) and in An. longipalpis C, 3.1% (0-RR, 28-RS, 233-SS) (Fig. 4a).'

african_field_population.evidence: Adult female mosquitoes were collected outdoors in three dryland areas of Kenya: Kerio Valley (Baringo County), Rabai (Kilifi County), and Nguruman (Kajiado County) (Page 1, Abstract; Page 6, Methodology).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article reporting original entomological collections, molecular species discrimination, Plasmodium detection, and resistance marker genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections occurred at specific sites within Kenya: Kapluk and Barwesa in Kerio Valley (Baringo County), Rabai (Kilifi County), and Nguruman (Kajiado County) (Page 6, Methodology).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected between August 2019 and May 2020 (Page 6, Methodology).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine primary field surveys conducted between August 2019 and May 2020 by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and sample sizes for GSTe2 L119F are provided in the main text on page 4.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated outdoor-trapped Anopheles in three dryland areas in Kenya (Kerio Valley, Rabai, and Nguruman) between August 2019 and May 2020. The authors tested An. funestus s.s. and An. longipalpis C for the GSTe2 L119F mutation using allele-specific PCR and sequencing, finding low frequencies of the resistant allele in Kerio Valley (1 RR, 3 RS, 12 SS in An. funestus s.s.; 0 RR, 28 RS, 233 SS in An. longipalpis C).
